method: Typed C reconstruction of the DirectDraw session-begin entry from the pinned EXE. Its source now directly calls the separate Ghidra-backed 0x004D0060 startup state machine; that address and the lower release helpers are recorded as supplemental because they have no compiled-reference binding rows.

verification.release_compile: passed with MSVC /W4 /WX; pharaoh_game and pharaoh_clean_bootstrap compiled
verification.reason: The counted 0x004D0220 source now calls the clean 0x004D0060 fallback state machine. The verified compiler build covers both; behavior tests were not repeated and no host game was run.

known_limitations: The lower DirectDraw enable/surface creation, mode-change, surface-context and debug/status endpoints remain typed runtime operations. 0x004D0060, 0x004D01E0, and 0x00426EE0 have no binding-inventory rows, so their implementations are supplemental and excluded from the counted migration batch.
